mapper.select: SELECT ri.id,ri.room_number,ri.rent,ai.id as apartment_id,ai.* FROM `room_info` AS ri LEFT JOIN apartment_info as ai ON ri.apartment_id=ai.id and ai.is_deleted=0 where ri.apartment_id=#{id} and ri.is_deleted=0 and ri.is_release=1 and ri.id not in ( SELECT room_id FROM lease_agreement WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND `status`IN(2,5) )
